'''Klaatu''' was a celestial object located in the [[Klaatu system/Legends|Klaatu system]], in the [[Airam sector/Legends|Airam sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. A [[Skirmish at Klaatu|space battle]] between the [[Airam (group)|Airam]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] took place near Klaatu during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="XWvTF:BoP" />

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power]]'' {{1stm}}
